points.K3: 确定酸碱对与对应的盐
points.K10: 认识部件，保护玻璃电极
points.K15: 配得准测得准，样品才稳定
points.S2: 先看标签和安全技术说明书
points.S5: 溅洒与接触的应急处置
points.S7: 废液与破损玻璃的处置

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，台上有烧杯、磁力搅拌器和pH计
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench with a glass beaker, a magnetic stirrer and a benchtop pH meter with a blank display, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲缓冲液配制和pH计使用。

shots.scene: 计算配制、滴定配制、pH计三个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row from left to right: a calculator next to a balance, a beaker with a dropper above it, and a pH meter probe. No people.
shots.narration: 两种配制方法，再加pH计的正确用法。

shots.scene: 阿杰对着空白实验方案挠头，旁边冰盒里放着蛋白样品管
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head while reading a blank protocol sheet; a small sample tube sits in an ice box beside him.
shots.narration: 阿杰的蛋白实验，要求pH固定不变。

shots.scene: 勺子把粉末随手倒进烧杯、没有天平的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A floating icon of a spoon tipping powder into a beaker with no balance nearby, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 他想随手溶点盐，差不多就行。

shots.scene: 小研拦住阿杰，指着空白计算本和计算器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student gently stops the young male student and points to a blank calculation notebook and a calculator on the desk.
shots.narration: 小研说：先选体系、算用量，再校准测量。

shots.scene: 小研把护目镜递给阿杰
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands a pair of safety goggles to the young male student next to the lab bench.
shots.narration: 动手之前，防护和规程也要准备好。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点头示意
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and nods encouragingly.
shots.narration: 我们一步一步来。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一个装着清澈液体的烧杯
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a beaker of clear liquid and smiles.
shots.narration: 缓冲液能抵抗加酸加碱带来的pH变化。

shots.scene: 两只烧杯各滴入一滴强酸，左边的指针大幅摆动
shots.prompt_en: Two beakers side by side, a drop falls into each from above; above the left beaker a needle gauge swings wildly. No people.
shots.narration: 同样滴几滴强酸，清水的pH变化很大。

shots.scene: 右边烧杯上方的指针几乎不动
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the right beaker; the needle gauge above it barely moves while drops fall in. No people.
shots.narration: 缓冲液的pH基本保持稳定。

shots.scene: 一面盾牌挡住落下的酸滴和碱滴
shots.prompt_en: A blue shield icon blocks falling drops shown as red and blue droplet pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 能中和多少强酸强碱，叫缓冲容量。

shots.scene: 浅色烧杯配小盾牌，深色烧杯配大盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Two beakers: a pale solution with a small shield icon and a deeper colored solution with a large shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 容量取决于弱酸和共轭碱的浓度。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着大盾牌竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the large shield icon and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 浓度越高，缓冲容量越大。

shots.scene: 小研在书桌前打开空白计算本，旁边浮现三张卡片
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sits at a desk with a blank calculation notebook; three blank cards float beside her.
shots.narration: 例一：为蛋白配一升50毫摩尔缓冲液。

shots.scene: 蛋白分子图标在一个笑脸温度计旁保持完整
shots.prompt_en: A simple protein molecule icon stays intact next to a smiling gauge icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这种蛋白在pH 7.3时最稳定。

shots.scene: 清单上两个勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist card with two checkboxes, both getting green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 第一步选体系：pH要稳，容量要够。

shots.scene: 数轴上目标点两侧各标出一段范围
shots.prompt_en: A horizontal number line with a highlighted target point and a shaded band one unit wide on each side. No people.
shots.narration: 弱酸的pKa，要在目标pH上下一个单位内。

shots.scene: 数轴上一个小球滑向目标点
shots.prompt_en: A small ball slides along the number line and stops right next to the target point. No people.
shots.narration: 越接近目标，效果越好。

shots.scene: 空白表格的五行，每行一个瓶子图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank table with five rows, each row with a small bottle pictogram and an empty cell. No people.
shots.narration: 对照常见弱酸的pKa表来挑选。

shots.scene: 第三行亮起，打上绿勾
shots.prompt_en: The third row of the blank table lights up and gets a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 磷酸二氢根pKa 6.82，最接近7.3。

shots.section_title: 确定酸碱对与对应的盐
shots.scene: 两只空白标签的试剂瓶，用箭头连到两个离子图标
shots.prompt_en: Two reagent jars with blank labels, each linked by an arrow to a simple ion icon above it. No people.
shots.narration: 弱酸是磷酸二氢根，共轭碱是磷酸氢根。
overlay: 确定酸碱对与对应的盐

shots.section_title: 确定酸碱对与对应的盐
shots.scene: 小研分别拿起两只试剂瓶对照
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student picks up two reagent jars with blank labels, one in each hand, and compares them.
shots.narration: 对应的盐是磷酸二氢钠和磷酸氢二钠。

shots.scene: 小研指着空白黑板，黑板旁浮现公式卡片
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at a blank chalkboard; a blank formula card floats beside it.
shots.narration: 用亨德森-哈塞尔巴尔赫方程求比例。

shots.scene: 两个数字卡片落进公式卡片
shots.prompt_en: Two blank number cards drop into slots on a blank formula card. No people.
shots.narration: 代入pH 7.3和pKa 6.82。

shots.scene: 天平图标，一侧略重
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale icon with a blue weight on one side slightly heavier than a red weight on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 算出共轭碱与弱酸之比约为1.6。

shots.scene: 两堆粉末，右堆比左堆大一些
shots.prompt_en: Two small piles of white powder on blank weighing boats, the right pile noticeably larger than the left. No people.
shots.narration: 磷酸氢二钠的量，是磷酸二氢钠的1.6倍。

shots.scene: 小研在计算本上写写算算
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes on a blank notebook page with a calculator beside her.
shots.narration: 再按总浓度和比例，算出各自用量。

shots.scene: 两块拼图合成一个整体
shots.prompt_en: Two puzzle pieces, one red and one blue, join to form one complete block. No people.
shots.narration: 酸和碱的浓度加起来，等于50毫摩尔。

shots.scene: 蓝色积木是红色积木的一倍半多
shots.prompt_en: A blue bar beside a red bar, the blue bar about one and a half times as long. No people.
shots.narration: 碱的浓度，等于酸的1.6倍。

shots.scene: 两个式子合并成一个
shots.prompt_en: Two blank equation cards slide together and merge into a single card. No people.
shots.narration: 两式联立：酸加1.6倍的酸，等于50。

shots.scene: 两个结果卡片弹出
shots.prompt_en: Two blank result cards pop up side by side with check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 解得酸19.2、碱30.8毫摩尔每升。

shots.scene: 天平上两只称量舟
shots.prompt_en: An analytical balance icon with two blank weighing boats beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 折算成一升：2.30克和4.37克。

shots.scene: 小研戴护目镜和手套，在分析天平上称量
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing a lab coat, safety goggles and gloves, weighs white powder on a weighing boat on an analytical balance.
shots.narration: 按计算结果，分别称取两种盐。

shots.scene: 小研把溶液倒进容量瓶，加蒸馏水
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours a clear solution into a one liter volumetric flask and adds distilled water from a wash bottle.
shots.narration: 溶解后加蒸馏水，定容到一升。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着pH计
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a benchtop pH meter with a blank display.
shots.narration: 配好后，最好再用pH计核对一下。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一只烧杯和一支滴管
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a beaker in one hand and a dropper in the other.
shots.narration: 方法二更简单准确，计算也少得多。

shots.scene: 三张卡片浮在试剂瓶旁
shots.prompt_en: Three blank cards float beside a white reagent jar with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 例二：配一升1.0毫摩尔Tris缓冲液。

shots.scene: 小研在计算本上写下一个数
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes a single number on a blank notebook page.
shots.narration: 目标pH 7.60，先算出弱碱用量。

shots.scene: 试剂瓶旁一个小称量舟
shots.prompt_en: A small blank weighing boat with a little white powder beside a reagent jar with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 1.0毫摩尔Tris，大约121毫克。

shots.scene: 小研往放在搅拌器上的大烧杯里倒蒸馏水，再放入搅拌子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing goggles and gloves, pours distilled water into a large beaker on a magnetic stirrer, then drops in a white stir bar.
shots.narration: 一升烧杯里先加约800毫升水和搅拌子。

shots.scene: 小研称好粉末，倒入烧杯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tips white powder from a weighing boat into the large beaker.
shots.narration: 称好121毫克Tris，倒进烧杯。

shots.scene: 小研用洗瓶冲洗称量舟，冲洗液流进烧杯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student rinses the empty weighing boat with a wash bottle, letting the rinse run into the beaker.
shots.narration: 冲洗称量舟，冲洗液也倒进烧杯。

shots.scene: 搅拌子转动，pH探头用夹子固定在液体中
shots.prompt_en: A beaker on a magnetic stirrer, the white stir bar spinning; a pH probe is held by a clamp in the liquid, away from the stir bar. No people.
shots.narration: 边搅拌，边用pH计监测。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手用滴管逐滴加液，仪表数字在变
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand adds liquid drop by drop with a dropper into the stirring beaker; the pH meter display shows changing blank segments.
shots.narration: 逐滴加入酸或碱溶液，调到7.60。

shots.scene: 欣欣在弱碱瓶旁举起一个酸滴图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a reagent jar with a blank label and holds up a red droplet icon.
shots.narration: Tris本身偏碱，从弱碱起步通常要加酸。

shots.scene: 三只滴瓶浓淡不同
shots.prompt_en: Three dropper bottles with blank labels containing liquids of light, medium and dark shades. No people.
shots.narration: 调节液浓度不必精确，但要选合适。

shots.scene: 一大桶淡色液体倒进烧杯，烧杯快满了
shots.prompt_en: A big jug of pale liquid pours into a beaker that is nearly overflowing, with a yellow warning triangle icon. No people.
shots.narration: 太稀，要加很大体积，把缓冲液冲淡。

shots.scene: 一滴深色液体让仪表指针冲过目标线
shots.prompt_en: One drop of dark liquid falls and a gauge needle shoots past a highlighted target line. No people.
shots.narration: 太浓，一滴下去就容易调过头。

shots.scene: 反向箭头把指针拉回目标线
shots.prompt_en: A curved reverse arrow pulls the gauge needle slowly back to the target line. No people.
shots.narration: 调过头，就用反向的酸或碱慢慢调回。

shots.scene: 小研借助漏斗把溶液倒入一升容量瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours the solution through a funnel into a one liter volumetric flask.
shots.narration: 把溶液转入一升容量瓶。

shots.scene: 小研用蒸馏水冲洗烧杯，洗液倒入容量瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student rinses the empty beaker with distilled water several times and pours each rinse into the volumetric flask.
shots.narration: 烧杯用蒸馏水洗几次，洗液并入瓶中。

shots.scene: 小研平视容量瓶刻度线，慢慢加水
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student bends down so her eyes are level with the mark on the flask neck and adds water slowly with a wash bottle.
shots.narration: 加水到刻度线，视线与刻度平齐。

shots.scene: 小研盖好瓶塞，上下颠倒容量瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stoppers the volumetric flask, holds the stopper with one hand and turns the flask upside down several times.
shots.narration: 盖紧瓶塞，反复颠倒混匀。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在pH计旁拍拍仪器
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a benchtop pH meter with a blank display and pats it.
shots.narration: 方法二离不开pH计，下面讲正确用法。

shots.scene: 复合电极剖面示意，内外两层
shots.prompt_en: A simple cutaway diagram of a combination pH probe: a thin glass bulb at the tip, an inner tube and an outer tube around it. No people.
shots.narration: pH计用玻璃电极测氢离子活度。

shots.scene: 外层参比电极高亮
shots.prompt_en: The outer tube of the probe diagram is highlighted, wrapped around the inner glass electrode. No people.
shots.narration: 玻璃电极外同轴套着银-氯化银参比电极。

shots.scene: 探头浸入溶液，一条发光的回路连起来
shots.prompt_en: The probe diagram dips into a beaker of solution and a glowing loop connects the probe, the solution and back. No people.
shots.narration: 探头浸入溶液，三者连成一条回路。

shots.scene: 回路上出现电压图标，仪表显示数值
shots.prompt_en: A small voltage icon appears on the glowing loop and the meter display lights up with blank segments. No people.
shots.narration: 内外pH不同产生电位差，仪表显示出来。

shots.section_title: 认识部件，保护玻璃电极
shots.scene: pH计三个部位依次高亮
shots.prompt_en: A benchtop pH meter with its display, the probe and the probe tip highlighted one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 主要部件：显示屏、探头和电极尖端。
overlay: 认识部件，保护玻璃电极

shots.section_title: 认识部件，保护玻璃电极
shots.scene: 电极尖端玻璃球泡特写，旁边有裂纹图标
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the thin glass bulb at the probe tip, with a small crack warning icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 尖端是很薄的玻璃球泡，容易碎。

shots.section_title: 认识部件，保护玻璃电极
shots.scene: 探头撞向烧杯壁的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a probe hitting the side of a beaker, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要让探头碰到烧杯壁。

shots.section_title: 认识部件，保护玻璃电极
shots.scene: 搅拌子碰到球泡的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a spinning stir bar hitting the probe bulb, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 用搅拌子时，探头要离它远一点。

shots.section_title: 认识部件，保护玻璃电极
shots.scene: 小研轻轻把探头放进烧杯并用夹子固定
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student gently lowers the probe into a beaker and fixes it in a clamp, well above the stir bar.
shots.narration: 放入和取出探头，动作都要轻。

shots.scene: 小研检查探头电缆是否插好
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks that the probe cable is firmly plugged into the back of the pH meter.
shots.narration: 先确认电极已经接好仪表。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一块空白的校准卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank card with a target icon.
shots.narration: 然后校准，不校准的读数不可信。

shots.scene: 电源图标和时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A power button icon and a clock icon side by side, each with a circular arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 每次开机都要重新校准。

shots.scene: 时钟指针转动，再次出现循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: The clock hands sweep forward several hours and the circular arrow lights up again. No people.
shots.narration: 连续用了三四个小时，也要再校准。

shots.scene: 两瓶不同颜色的标准液
shots.prompt_en: Two small bottles with blank labels, one with red liquid and one with blue liquid, in front of a pH meter. No people.
shots.narration: 两点校准：用两种已知pH的标准液。

shots.scene: 小研打开pH计，选择显示模式
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student switches on the pH meter and presses a mode key on its blank keypad.
shots.narration: 开机，选0.1或0.01的显示精度。

shots.scene: 小研按一个按键，屏幕亮起
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student presses one key on the blank keypad and the display lights up.
shots.narration: 按等电位键，核对读数是否为7.00。

shots.scene: 小研在废液杯上方用洗瓶冲洗探头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student rinses the probe with a wash bottle over an empty waste beaker.
shots.narration: 蒸馏水冲洗探头，冲洗水接进废液杯。

shots.scene: 小研用无尘纸轻轻吸干探头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student gently blots the probe tip with a plain white lint-free tissue.
shots.narration: 用无尘纸轻轻吸干，不要用力擦。

shots.scene: 小研把探头放入第一种标准液，按校准键
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places the probe into the first small bottle of standard buffer and presses a key on the meter.
shots.narration: 放入第一种标准液，按校准键。

shots.scene: 屏幕交替闪烁
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the meter display flashing alternately between two blank segment patterns. No people.
shots.narration: 屏幕交替显示数字1和读数。

shots.scene: 读数停住，手指按确认键
shots.prompt_en: The display stops flashing and holds steady; a gloved finger presses a key.
shots.narration: 读数稳定后，按确认键。

shots.scene: 屏幕上出现新的闪烁
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the meter display showing a new single blank symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 屏幕出现数字2，准备第二点。

shots.scene: 小研再次冲洗、吸干探头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student rinses the probe again over the waste beaker and blots it with a lint-free tissue.
shots.narration: 再次冲洗吸干，放入第二种标准液。

shots.scene: 红色标准液瓶旁亮起酸性图标
shots.prompt_en: The red standard buffer bottle glows next to an acid droplet icon. No people.
shots.narration: 样品偏酸，用pH 4.01的标准液。

shots.scene: 蓝色标准液瓶旁亮起碱性图标
shots.prompt_en: The blue standard buffer bottle glows next to a base droplet icon. No people.
shots.narration: 样品偏碱，用pH 10.01的标准液。

shots.scene: 屏幕交替闪烁后停住，手指按确认
shots.prompt_en: The display flashes alternately, then holds steady; a gloved finger presses a key.
shots.narration: 交替显示2和读数，稳定后按确认。

shots.scene: 屏幕显示就绪，小研点头
shots.prompt_en: The meter display shows a steady ready symbol and the female graduate student nods.
shots.narration: 屏幕显示pH，就可以开始测量了。

shots.scene: 温度计图标与缓冲液瓶并排
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon next to a bottle of buffer with a blank label and a thermostat dial icon. No people.
shots.narration: 测量前，样品温度要和实验温度一致。

shots.scene: 温度计升降，指针跟着变化
shots.prompt_en: As the thermometer level rises and falls, a gauge needle beside it moves too. No people.
shots.narration: 因为pH会随温度变化。

shots.scene: 小研冲洗吸干探头，放入待测缓冲液
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student rinses and blots the probe, then places it into a beaker of buffer sample.
shots.narration: 冲洗吸干探头，放入待测缓冲液。

shots.scene: 小研在实验记录本上写下读数
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student waits for the display to settle, then writes in a blank lab notebook.
shots.narration: 等读数稳定，再记录pH值。

shots.section_title: 配得准测得准，样品才稳定
shots.scene: 欣欣捧着装有蛋白样品的冰盒
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a small ice box with sample tubes and smiles.
shots.narration: 缓冲液配得准，pH测得准，
overlay: 配得准测得准，样品才稳定

shots.section_title: 配得准测得准，样品才稳定
shots.scene: 蛋白分子图标闪着健康的绿光
shots.prompt_en: A protein molecule icon glows healthy green next to a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 蛋白和其他敏感试剂才能长期保持活性。

shots.scene: 王老师给阿杰讲解仪器操作规程
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains a blank operating procedure card to the young male student next to a pH meter.
shots.narration: 第一次用pH计，先培训，再看操作规程。

shots.scene: 阿杰在空白使用登记本上签字
shots.prompt_en: The young male student signs a blank instrument logbook beside the pH meter.
shots.narration: 使用前后登记，发现故障及时报告。

shots.section_title: 先看标签和安全技术说明书
shots.scene: 小研对照试剂瓶阅读空白的安全技术说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads a blank safety data sheet next to a reagent bottle with a blank label.
shots.narration: 称量滴加前，先看标签和安全技术说明书。
overlay: 先看标签和安全技术说明书

shots.section_title: 先看标签和安全技术说明书
shots.scene: 试剂瓶上的腐蚀象形图
shots.prompt_en: A GHS corrosion hazard pictogram in a red diamond on a blank bottle label. No people.
shots.narration: 强酸强碱溶液有腐蚀性，留意象形图。

shots.section_title: 先看标签和安全技术说明书
shots.scene: 王老师在领用登记本上核对
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks a blank chemical use register at a reagent cabinet.
shots.narration: 盐酸属管控化学品，领用要按规定登记。

shots.scene: 小研穿实验服、戴护目镜和手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands at the bench wearing a buttoned lab coat, safety goggles and nitrile gloves.
shots.narration: 实验服、护目镜、手套，一样不少。

shots.scene: 露趾凉鞋和披散长发的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of open-toe sandals and loose long hair, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 长发扎起，不穿露趾鞋。

shots.scene: 酸滴图标沿杯壁流进水里，反向的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of acid poured slowly into a beaker of water with a green check, and an icon of water poured into acid crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 稀释浓酸，要把酸慢慢加入水中。

shots.scene: 小研滴加时脸离烧杯较远
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student adds drops into a beaker that sits steady on the bench, keeping her face well back from it.
shots.narration: 滴加时容器放稳，脸不要凑近。

shots.scene: 柜子里酸和碱分开两格存放
shots.prompt_en: A chemical cabinet with two separate shelves, red droplet icons on one and blue droplet icons on the other, all caps closed. No people.
shots.narration: 酸和碱分开存放，瓶盖拧紧。

shots.section_title: 溅洒与接触的应急处置
shots.scene: 洗眼器标志，旁边是洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash sign above a lab eyewash station with water flowing. No people.
shots.narration: 溅入眼睛，立即到洗眼器用流水冲洗。
overlay: 溅洒与接触的应急处置

shots.section_title: 溅洒与接触的应急处置
shots.scene: 小研在水槽边用大量流水冲手臂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student rinses her forearm under running water at a lab sink.
shots.narration: 溅到皮肤，脱去污染衣物，大量清水冲。

shots.section_title: 溅洒与接触的应急处置
shots.scene: 小研用吸附垫处理台面少量溅洒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing goggles and gloves, covers a small spill on the bench with absorbent pads.
shots.narration: 台面少量溅洒，按规程吸附后清理。

shots.section_title: 溅洒与接触的应急处置
shots.scene: 阿杰向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports to the older man in the lab doorway; the older man listens and nods.
shots.narration: 事后报告实验室负责人，必要时就医。

shots.section_title: 溅洒与接触的应急处置
shots.scene: 电话图标上显示急救号码
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 伤情严重，拨打120求救。

shots.scene: 小研给缓冲液瓶贴空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sticks a blank label onto a bottle of freshly made buffer.
shots.narration: 贴好标签：名称、浓度、pH、日期、配制人。

shots.scene: 探头冲净后套上装有保存液的保护帽
shots.prompt_en: A rinsed pH probe gets a small protective cap filled with storage solution fitted over its tip. No people.
shots.narration: 电极用完冲净，套上装保存液的保护帽。

shots.scene: 探头干放和泡在蒸馏水里的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a probe lying dry on the bench and a probe standing in a cup of plain water, both crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要干放，也不要长期泡在蒸馏水里。

shots.scene: 电线远离液体，湿手碰插头的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The pH meter cable runs away from beakers; a separate icon of a wet hand touching a plug is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 电线远离液体，湿手不碰插头开关。

shots.section_title: 废液与破损玻璃的处置
shots.scene: 小研把废液倒入有空白标签的废液桶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours waste liquid from the waste beaker into a closed waste container with a blank label.
shots.narration: 冲洗液和废弃溶液，按本校规定分类收集。
overlay: 废液与破损玻璃的处置

shots.section_title: 废液与破损玻璃的处置
shots.scene: 倒向水槽的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of liquid poured into a sink drain, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要随意倒进下水道。

shots.section_title: 废液与破损玻璃的处置
shots.scene: 破损的电极放进锐器盒
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand drops a broken glass probe tip into a rigid sharps box.
shots.narration: 电极破损，碎玻璃放进专用锐器盒。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现天平和容量瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a balance and a volumetric flask.
shots.narration: 选体系、算比例、称量、定容。

shots.scene: 滴管和指针回到目标线的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a dropper and a gauge needle settling on a target line. No people.
shots.narration: 边测边调pH，过头就反向回调。

shots.scene: pH计、两瓶标准液和受保护的电极
shots.prompt_en: A pH meter, two small standard buffer bottles and a probe with a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: pH计先校准，轻拿轻放护电极。

shots.scene: 护目镜、手套和废液桶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of safety goggles, gloves and a closed waste container in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 做好防护，规范处置废液。

shots.scene: 欣欣在实验台前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera in front of a tidy lab bench.
shots.narration: 规范操作，安全实验，下次见！
